title: Know What Pulls You
devotional: Temptation often becomes easier to recognize when you learn your own patterns. James teaches that people can be drawn away by their own desires. That does not mean you should live in fear of yourself. It means you should become honest about the situations where you are most vulnerable. Pay attention to what happens before the temptation gets strong. Maybe it begins when you are bored, angry, lonely, tired, stressed, scrolling late at night, or spending time in an environment that repeatedly leads you somewhere you do not want to go. You cannot change a pattern you refuse to notice. Today, don't simply ask what you did wrong. Ask what happened before it.
mind_check: What usually happens in the minutes or hours before you face your strongest temptation?
body_move: Identify one physical situation that repeatedly puts you in a vulnerable position and make one practical change today.
spirit_move: Bring your pattern honestly before God. Ask Him to help you recognize the warning signs before the temptation becomes overwhelming.
way_out: My warning sign is __________. When I notice it, I will __________.
prayer: Father, help me become honest about the patterns that make me vulnerable. Give me wisdom to recognize the warning signs before temptation grows stronger. Help me make practical changes instead of repeatedly walking into the same situation. Teach me to depend on You and choose the way out. Amen.
action: Write down three things that commonly appear before you are tempted: a place, a feeling, a time, a person, an activity, or a thought. Circle the one you can change most easily.
